name: Coastal Elegance at Snug Harbor
tagline: Five new waterfront residences with private boat slips
propertyType: New elevated luxury two- and three-bedroom waterfront residences with available private boat slips
summary: Coastal Elegance at Snug Harbor is a collection of just five new, elevated luxury two- and three-bedroom waterfront residences at 13655 Gulf Blvd in Madeira Beach, with assigned private boat slips available. The building sits across the street from the beach and a short walk from John's Pass Village. Construction is complete and residences are move-in ready, with bulk packages available. Owners may rent for 1–7 day stays or use the home as a primary residence/homestead, subject to eligibility.

faqs.q: Can Coastal Elegance at Snug Harbor be rented short term?
faqs.a: Yes. Residences permit 1–7 day rentals and may also serve as a primary residence/homestead, subject to eligibility.

faqs.q: Does Coastal Elegance at Snug Harbor include a boat slip?
faqs.a: Assigned private boat slips are available with the residences.

faqs.q: Is Coastal Elegance at Snug Harbor move-in ready?
faqs.a: Yes. Construction is complete and residences are move-in ready now. Bulk packages are available.

faqs.q: What deposit and financing are available at Coastal Elegance at Snug Harbor?
faqs.a: The initial deposit is $10,000 with a total down payment of 20%. Buyers may use cash, conventional, DSCR or investment loans, subject to lender approval.
